content: Endpoint DLP agents use a pull-based sync model: on startup/login they upload endpoint attributes and download applicable policies, then re-sync periodically (e.g., every 90 minutes) and maintain a continuous thin connection for real-time requests. Policies are cached locally so enforcement continues offline. Events and audit logs are stored in a local encrypted queue and uploaded on reconnect. New policies created while offline are not enforced until reconnection, but existing cached policies remain active.
